name: False alarm: a cow at the fence
notes: N1110 (rhythm, item 5). Played by FS47Calm (S47Calm.cpp), once or twice a night in the evening hours, when nothing else is on. It sounds like the start of something and is a cow leaning on the wire. Silence first, then the ordinary reveal. No finding, no map mark, no danger, no camera.

beats.text: A cow. Just a cow, leaning on the wire and looking at me.
